CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION bob_dashboard_private.indicator_rows_v1(target_club uuid, p_indicator text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, row_data jsonb, monetary_value numeric, sort_number integer, sort_date date, sort_time timestamp with time zone, sort_text text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null or not public.has_club_access(target_club) then
    raise exception 'Sem acesso ao clube.' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  case p_indicator
    when 'members', 'prospects' then
      return query
      select m.id, jsonb_build_object(
        'id', m.id, 'member_number', m.member_number,
        'full_name', m.full_name, 'nickname', m.nickname
      ), null::numeric, m.member_number, null::date, null::timestamptz, m.full_name
      from public.members m
      where m.club_id = target_club and (
        (p_indicator = 'members' and
          m.status::text not in ('prospect','former','deceased')) or
        (p_indicator = 'prospects' and m.status::text = 'prospect')
      );
    when 'total_balance' then
      return query
      select a.id, jsonb_build_object(
        'id', a.id, 'name', a.name, 'balance', b.balance
      ), b.balance, null::integer, null::date, null::timestamptz, a.name
      from public.treasury_accounts a
      cross join lateral (
        select a.opening_balance
          + coalesce((select sum(case
              when t.kind::text = 'income' then t.amount
              when t.kind::text in ('expense','transfer') then -t.amount
              else 0 end)
            from public.treasury_transactions t
            where t.club_id = target_club and t.account_id = a.id), 0)
          + coalesce((select sum(t.amount)
            from public.treasury_transactions t
            where t.club_id = target_club and t.kind::text = 'transfer'
              and t.destination_account_id = a.id), 0) as balance
      ) b
      where a.club_id = target_club and a.active = true;
    when 'fee_outstanding' then
      return query
      select f.id, jsonb_build_object(
        'id', f.id, 'member_name', m.full_name,
        'outstanding', greatest(f.amount - f.paid_amount, 0),
        'due_date', f.due_date
      ), greatest(f.amount - f.paid_amount, 0),
      null::integer, f.due_date, null::timestamptz, m.full_name
      from public.fee_obligations f
      left join public.members m on m.id = f.member_id and m.club_id = f.club_id
      where f.club_id = target_club and greatest(f.amount - f.paid_amount, 0) > 0;
    when 'open_events' then
      return query
      select e.id, jsonb_build_object(
        'id', e.id, 'name', e.name, 'starts_at', e.starts_at, 'status', e.status
      ), null::numeric, null::integer, null::date, e.starts_at, e.name
      from public.events e
      where e.club_id = target_club
        and e.status::text not in ('completed','cancelled','archived');
    when 'low_stock' then
      return query
      select p.id, jsonb_build_object(
        'id', p.id, 'name', p.name, 'current_stock', p.current_stock,
        'reserved_stock', p.reserved_stock,
        'available_stock', p.current_stock - p.reserved_stock,
        'minimum_stock', p.minimum_stock
      ), null::numeric, null::integer, null::date, null::timestamptz, p.name
      from public.products p
      where p.club_id = target_club and p.active = true
        and p.current_stock - p.reserved_stock <= p.minimum_stock;
    when 'expiring_documents' then
      return query
      select d.id, jsonb_build_object(
        'id', d.id, 'name', d.name, 'expires_at', d.expires_at
      ), null::numeric, null::integer, d.expires_at, null::timestamptz, d.name
      from public.documents d
      where d.club_id = target_club
        and d.expires_at between current_date and current_date + 30;
    when 'pending_approvals' then
      if not public.financial_manager_v1(target_club) then
        raise exception 'Sem autorização para consultar aprovações.' using errcode = '42501';
      end if;
      return query
      select r.id, jsonb_build_object(
        'id', r.id, 'request_type', r.request_type,
        'description', r.description, 'amount', r.amount,
        'requested_by', r.requested_by,
        'requester_name', requester.name,
        -- A missing name is real missing/blank data, never a silent RLS omission.
        'requester_name_missing', requester.name is null,
        'status', r.status
      ), null::numeric, null::integer, null::date, r.created_at, null::text
      from public.financial_requests r
      cross join lateral (
        select bob_dashboard_private.approval_requester_name_v1(target_club,r.id) as name
      ) requester
      where r.club_id = target_club
        and r.status in ('pending_review','awaiting_validation');
    else
      raise exception 'Indicador desconhecido.' using errcode = '22023';
  end case;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION bob_dinner_private.live_result(target_club uuid, p_dinner uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare f public.weekly_dinner_finances%rowtype; b record; e record;
  meal_q numeric; meal_r numeric; food numeric; others numeric; revenue numeric; cost numeric;
  links jsonb; sales jsonb;
begin
  select * into f from public.weekly_dinner_finances where dinner_id=p_dinner and club_id=target_club;
  with dinner_lines as (
    select i.*, c.component_override,
      coalesce(c.component_override,i.dinner_component_snapshot) effective_component
    from public.bar_sales s join public.bar_sale_items i on i.sale_id=s.id and i.club_id=s.club_id
      left join public.weekly_dinner_sale_item_classifications c
        on c.club_id=s.club_id and c.dinner_id=p_dinner and c.sale_item_id=i.id
    where s.club_id=target_club and s.weekly_dinner_id=p_dinner and s.status='completed'
  )
  select coalesce(sum(i.quantity) filter(where i.effective_component='meal'),0) meal_quantity,
    coalesce(sum(i.line_total) filter(where i.effective_component='meal'),0) meal_revenue,
    coalesce(sum(i.line_total) filter(where i.effective_component='bar'),0) beverage_revenue,
    coalesce(sum(i.cost_total_snapshot) filter(where i.effective_component='bar'),0) beverage_cost,
    count(*) filter(where (i.effective_component='bar' and i.cost_total_snapshot is null)
      or i.effective_component is null) missing_cost_count,
    coalesce(sum(i.line_total) filter(where i.effective_component='excluded'),0) excluded_revenue,
    count(*) filter(where i.effective_component='excluded') excluded_line_count,
    coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sale_item_id',i.id,'sale_id',i.sale_id,
      'description',i.description,'quantity',i.quantity,'unit_price',i.unit_price,'line_total',i.line_total,
      'original_component',i.dinner_component_snapshot,'component_override',i.component_override,
      'effective_component',i.effective_component) order by i.sale_id,i.id)
      filter(where i.dinner_component_snapshot='excluded' and i.line_total>0),'[]'::jsonb) classification_lines
  into b from dinner_lines i;
  -- Reversed expense originals contribute zero; reversal entries are never links.
  select coalesce(sum(t.amount) filter(where l.cost_kind='food' and not exists(
      select 1 from public.treasury_transactions r where r.reversal_of=t.id)),0) food,
    coalesce(sum(t.amount) filter(where l.cost_kind='other' and not exists(
      select 1 from public.treasury_transactions r where r.reversal_of=t.id)),0) other
    into e from public.weekly_dinner_expenses l join public.treasury_transactions t on t.id=l.transaction_id
    where l.club_id=target_club and l.dinner_id=p_dinner;
  meal_q:=b.meal_quantity;
  meal_r:=b.meal_revenue;
  food:=coalesce(f.food_cost_manual,0)+e.food; others:=coalesce(f.other_cost_manual,0)+e.other;
  revenue:=meal_r+b.beverage_revenue; cost:=food+b.beverage_cost+others;
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',l.id,'transaction_id',t.id,'cost_kind',l.cost_kind,
    'description',t.description,'amount',t.amount,'reversed',exists(select 1 from public.treasury_transactions r where r.reversal_of=t.id))
    order by t.transaction_date,t.id),'[]'::jsonb) into links
    from public.weekly_dinner_expenses l join public.treasury_transactions t on t.id=l.transaction_id
    where l.club_id=target_club and l.dinner_id=p_dinner;
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',s.id,'customer_label',s.customer_label,'total_amount',s.total_amount,'completed_at',s.completed_at)
    order by s.completed_at,s.id),'[]'::jsonb) into sales from public.bar_sales s
    where s.club_id=target_club and s.weekly_dinner_id=p_dinner and s.status='completed';
  return jsonb_build_object('meal_quantity',meal_q,'meal_revenue',meal_r,'food_cost',food,'meal_profit',meal_r-food,
    'bar_meal_quantity',b.meal_quantity,'bar_meal_revenue',b.meal_revenue,'beverage_revenue',b.beverage_revenue,
    'beverage_cost',case when b.missing_cost_count=0 then b.beverage_cost else null end,
    'beverage_profit',case when b.missing_cost_count=0 then b.beverage_revenue-b.beverage_cost else null end,
    'food_cost_linked',e.food,'other_cost_linked',e.other,'other_costs',others,'total_revenue',revenue,
    'total_cost',case when b.missing_cost_count=0 then cost else null end,
    'result',case when b.missing_cost_count=0 then revenue-cost else null end,
    'margin_percent',case when b.missing_cost_count>0 then null when revenue>0 then (revenue-cost)/revenue*100 else 0 end,
    'missing_cost_count',b.missing_cost_count,'excluded_revenue',b.excluded_revenue,'excluded_line_count',b.excluded_line_count,'classification_lines',b.classification_lines,'expense_links',links,'sales',sales);
end $function$

 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, activity_type text, title text, description text, entity_type text, entity_id uuid, metadata jsonb, created_at timestamp with time zone, actor_name text, portugal_date text, portugal_time text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql

begin

  select
    a.id,
    a.activity_type,
    a.title,
    a.description,
    a.entity_type,
    a.entity_id,
    a.metadata,
    a.created_at,
    coalesce(p.full_name, 'Sistema')::text,
    to_char(a.created_at at time zone 'Europe/Lisbon', 'DD/MM/YYYY')::text,
    to_char(a.created_at at time zone 'Europe/Lisbon', 'HH24:MI:SS')::text
  from public.activity_feed a

  where a.club_id = target_club
    and (
      p_module is null
      or p_module = ''
      or p_module = 'all'
      or coalesce(a.metadata->>'module_code', a.activity_type) = p_module
    )
  order by a.created_at desc
  limit greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit, 100), 500));

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.agenda_calendar_v1(target_club uuid, p_from date, p_to date)
 RETURNS TABLE(item_id uuid, source_type text, item_kind text, title text, subtitle text, starts_at timestamp with time zone, ends_at timestamp with time zone, all_day boolean, priority text, item_status text, action_route text, entity_id uuid, can_edit boolean, metadata jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_member uuid;
  v_manage_agenda boolean;
  v_manage_fees boolean;
  v_view_docs boolean;
  v_sensitive_docs boolean;
  v_manage_docs boolean;
  v_profile uuid;
  v_manage_events boolean;
begin
  if (select auth.uid()) is null or not public.has_club_access(target_club) then
    raise exception 'Sem acesso ao clube.';
  end if;
  if not public.has_club_permission(target_club,'viewAgenda') then
    raise exception 'Sem permissão para consultar a Agenda.';
  end if;
  if p_from is null or p_to is null or p_to<p_from or p_to-p_from>400 then
    raise exception 'Intervalo da Agenda inválido.';
  end if;

  v_member:=public.agenda_current_member_v1(target_club);
  v_manage_agenda:=public.can_manage_agenda_v1(target_club);
  v_manage_fees:=public.has_club_permission(target_club,'manageFees');
  v_view_docs:=public.has_club_permission(target_club,'viewDocuments');
  v_sensitive_docs:=public.has_club_permission(
    target_club,'viewSensitiveDocuments'
  );
  v_manage_events:=public.has_club_permission(target_club,'manageEvents');
  v_manage_docs:=public.has_club_permission(target_club,'manageDocuments');
  v_profile:=(select auth.uid());

  return query
  with years as (
    select generate_series(
      extract(year from p_from)::int,
      extract(year from p_to)::int
    ) as y
  ),
  member_dates as (
    select m.id,'birthday'::text as kind,m.birth_date as src_date,
           'Aniversário — '||coalesce(nullif(m.nickname,''),m.full_name) as label
    from public.members m
    where m.club_id=target_club
      and m.birth_date is not null
      and m.status::text not in ('former','deceased')
    union all
    select m.id,'prospect'::text,m.prospect_joined_at,
           'Prospect — '||coalesce(nullif(m.nickname,''),m.full_name)
    from public.members m
    where m.club_id=target_club
      and m.prospect_joined_at is not null
      and m.status::text not in ('former','deceased')
    union all
    select m.id,'full_colors'::text,m.full_colors_at,
           'Full Colors — '||coalesce(nullif(m.nickname,''),m.full_name)
    from public.members m
    where m.club_id=target_club
      and m.full_colors_at is not null
      and m.status::text not in ('former','deceased')
  ),
  anniversaries as (
    select md.*,public.agenda_anniversary_date_v1(md.src_date,y.y) as agenda_date
    from member_dates md cross join years y
  )
  select
    a.id,'agenda'::text,a.item_type,a.title,
    concat_ws(
      ' · ',
      nullif(a.location,''),
      case when a.audience='direction' then 'Direção' else null end
    ),
    a.starts_at,a.ends_at,a.all_day,a.priority,a.status,
    'agenda'::text,a.id,v_manage_agenda,
    jsonb_build_object('audience',a.audience,'description',a.description)
  from public.agenda_items a
  where a.club_id=target_club
    and a.starts_at < ((p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Europe/Lisbon')
    and coalesce(a.ends_at,a.starts_at) >=
        (p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Europe/Lisbon')
    and (
      a.audience='all'
      or public.can_view_direction_agenda_v1(target_club)
    )

  union all

  select
    e.id,'event'::text,'event'::text,e.name,e.location,
    e.starts_at,e.ends_at,false,'normal'::text,e.status::text,
    'events'::text,e.id,v_manage_events,
    jsonb_build_object('description',e.description)
  from public.events e
  where e.club_id=target_club
    and e.starts_at is not null
    and public.has_club_permission(target_club,'viewEvents')
    and (e.status::text<>'draft' or v_manage_events)
    and e.starts_at < ((p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Europe/Lisbon')
    and coalesce(e.ends_at,e.starts_at) >=
        (p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Europe/Lisbon')

  union all

  select
    an.id,'member'::text,an.kind,an.label,null::text,
    (an.agenda_date::timestamp at time zone 'Europe/Lisbon'),
    null::timestamptz,true,'normal'::text,'active'::text,
    'members'::text,an.id,false,
    jsonb_build_object('original_date',an.src_date,'kind',an.kind)
  from anniversaries an
  where an.agenda_date between p_from and p_to
    and public.has_club_permission(target_club,'viewMembers')

  union all

  select
    wd.id,'weekly_dinner'::text,
    case
      when wd.dinner_kind='extraordinary' then 'dinner_extraordinary'
      else 'dinner'
    end,
    case
      when wd.status='closed' then 'Jantar — Club House fechado'
      else 'Jantar — '||
        coalesce(
          nullif(m.nickname,''),m.full_name,
          nullif(wd.external_name,''),'Por definir'
        )
    end,
    nullif(wd.dish,''),
    (wd.dinner_date::timestamp at time zone 'Europe/Lisbon'),
    null::timestamptz,true,'normal'::text,wd.status,
    'weekly_officer'::text,wd.id,false,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'dinner_kind',wd.dinner_kind,
      'assigned_member_id',wd.assigned_member_id,
      'external_name',wd.external_name
    )
  from public.weekly_dinners wd
  left join public.members m
    on m.id=wd.assigned_member_id and m.club_id=wd.club_id
  where wd.club_id=target_club
    and wd.dinner_date between p_from and p_to

  union all

  select
    d.id,'document'::text,'deadline'::text,
    'Validade — '||d.name,d.category,
    (d.expires_at::timestamp at time zone 'Europe/Lisbon'),
    null::timestamptz,true,
    case when d.expires_at<current_date then 'high' else 'normal' end,
    case when d.expires_at<current_date then 'overdue' else 'planned' end,
    'documents'::text,d.id,false,
    jsonb_build_object('sensitive',d.sensitive,'category',d.category)
  from public.documents d
  where d.club_id=target_club
    and d.expires_at between p_from and p_to
    -- Keep this visibility predicate aligned with the documents_select policy.
    and (
      (d.scope='personal' and (d.owner_profile_id=v_profile or v_manage_docs))
      or (d.scope='leadership' and v_sensitive_docs)
      or (
        d.scope in ('club','event_gallery','annual_book')
        and v_view_docs
        and (d.sensitive=false or v_sensitive_docs)
      )
    )

  union all

  select
    fo.id,'fee'::text,'charge'::text,
    case
      when v_manage_fees then
        'Cobrança — '||coalesce(nullif(m.nickname,''),m.full_name)
      else 'Cobrança pendente'
    end,
    to_char(
      greatest(fo.amount-coalesce(fo.paid_amount,0),0),
      'FM999999990.00'
    )||' €',
    (fo.due_date::timestamp at time zone 'Europe/Lisbon'),
    null::timestamptz,true,
    case when fo.due_date<current_date then 'high' else 'normal' end,
    fo.status::text,'fees'::text,fo.id,false,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'reference_year',fo.reference_year,
      'reference_month',fo.reference_month
    )
  from public.fee_obligations fo
  join public.members m
    on m.id=fo.member_id and m.club_id=fo.club_id
  where fo.club_id=target_club
    and fo.due_date between p_from and p_to
    and fo.status::text in ('pending','partial')
    and (v_manage_fees or fo.member_id=v_member)

  order by starts_at,title;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.alerts_v1(target_club uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(title text, type text, date date)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with source_milestones as (
    select
      member.full_name,
      milestone.type,
      milestone.label,
      milestone.original_date
    from public.members member
    cross join lateral (
      values
        ('birthday', 'Aniversário', member.birth_date),
        ('prospect', 'Entrada como Prospect', member.prospect_joined_at),
        ('full_colors', 'Full Color', member.full_colors_at)
    ) as milestone(type, label, original_date)
    where member.club_id = target_club
      and milestone.original_date is not null
  ),
  milestone_dates as (
    select
      full_name,
      type,
      label,
      original_date,
      make_date(
        extract(year from current_date)::integer,
        extract(month from original_date)::integer,
        extract(day from original_date)::integer
      ) as this_year
    from source_milestones
  )
  select
    label || ': ' || full_name,
    type,
    case
      when this_year >= current_date
        then this_year
      else (this_year + interval '1 year')::date
    end
  from milestone_dates
  where case
    when this_year >= current_date
      then this_year
    else (this_year + interval '1 year')::date
  end <= current_date + 30

  union all

  select
    'Stock baixo: ' || product.name,
    'stock',
    current_date
  from public.products product
  where product.club_id = target_club
    and product.active = true
    and product.current_stock <= product.minimum_stock

  union all

  select
    'Documento a expirar: ' || document.name,
    'document',
    document.expires_at
  from public.documents document
  where document.club_id = target_club
    and document.expires_at between current_date and current_date + 30;
$function$

    select s.id,s.completed_at,jsonb_build_object('id',s.id,'status',s.status,'completed_at',s.completed_at,

        from public.bar_sale_items i where i.club_id=target_club and i.sale_id=s.id),'[]'::jsonb)) as row_data

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.budget_performance_v1(target_club uuid, p_budget uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(line_id uuid, label text, line_type text, planned_amount numeric, actual_amount numeric, variance_amount numeric, cost_center_id uuid, event_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_budget public.budgets%rowtype;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null or not public.has_club_permission(target_club,'viewTreasury') then
    raise exception 'Sem acesso à tesouraria.';
  end if;
  select * into v_budget from public.budgets where id=p_budget and club_id=target_club;
  if not found then raise exception 'Orçamento não encontrado.'; end if;

  return query
  select
    l.id,
    l.label,
    l.line_type,
    l.planned_amount,
    coalesce(sum(t.amount) filter (
      where t.id is not null
        and t.reversal_of is null
        and not exists(select 1 from public.treasury_transactions r where r.reversal_of=t.id)
    ),0)::numeric as actual_amount,
    (coalesce(sum(t.amount) filter (
      where t.id is not null
        and t.reversal_of is null
        and not exists(select 1 from public.treasury_transactions r where r.reversal_of=t.id)
    ),0)-l.planned_amount)::numeric as variance_amount,
    l.cost_center_id,
    l.event_id
  from public.budget_lines l
  left join public.treasury_transactions t
    on t.club_id=l.club_id
   and t.transaction_date between v_budget.period_start and v_budget.period_end
   and t.kind::text=l.line_type
   and (l.cost_center_id is null or t.cost_center_id=l.cost_center_id)
   and (l.event_id is null or t.event_id=l.event_id)
  where l.club_id=target_club and l.budget_id=p_budget
  group by l.id,l.label,l.line_type,l.planned_amount,l.cost_center_id,l.event_id,l.created_at
  order by l.created_at,l.label;
end;
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dashboard_summary(target_club uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  total_balance numeric(14,2);
  month_income numeric(14,2);
  month_expense numeric(14,2);
  pending_fees integer;
  active_members integer;
  unread_notifications integer;
  next_event jsonb;
  account_rows jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  can_financial boolean;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null or not public.has_club_access(target_club) then
    raise exception 'Sem acesso ao clube.' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  can_financial := public.has_club_permission(target_club, 'viewTreasury');

  if can_financial then
    select coalesce(sum(
      a.opening_balance
      + coalesce((
        select sum(
          case
            when t.kind = 'income' then t.amount
            when t.kind = 'expense' then -t.amount
            when t.kind = 'transfer' and t.account_id = a.id then -t.amount
            when t.kind = 'transfer' and t.destination_account_id = a.id then t.amount
            when t.kind = 'reversal' then 0
            else 0
          end
        )
        from public.treasury_transactions t
        where t.club_id = target_club
          and (t.account_id = a.id or t.destination_account_id = a.id)
      ), 0)
    ), 0)
    into total_balance
    from public.treasury_accounts a
    where a.club_id = target_club
      and a.active = true;

    select coalesce(sum(amount), 0)
    into month_income
    from public.treasury_transactions
    where club_id = target_club
      and kind = 'income'
      and date_trunc('month', transaction_date::timestamp)
        = date_trunc('month', now());

    select coalesce(sum(amount), 0)
    into month_expense
    from public.treasury_transactions
    where club_id = target_club
      and kind = 'expense'
      and date_trunc('month', transaction_date::timestamp)
        = date_trunc('month', now());

    select count(*)
    into pending_fees
    from public.fee_obligations
    where club_id = target_club
      and status in ('pending', 'partial')
      and (due_date is null or due_date <= current_date);

    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(row_data order by name), '[]'::jsonb)
    into account_rows
    from (
      select
        a.id,
        a.name,
        a.account_type,
        (
          a.opening_balance
          + coalesce((
            select sum(
              case
                when t.kind = 'income' then t.amount
                when t.kind = 'expense' then -t.amount
                when t.kind = 'transfer' and t.account_id = a.id then -t.amount
                when t.kind = 'transfer' and t.destination_account_id = a.id then t.amount
                else 0
              end
            )
            from public.treasury_transactions t
            where t.club_id = target_club
              and (t.account_id = a.id or t.destination_account_id = a.id)
          ), 0)
        ) as balance
      from public.treasury_accounts a
      where a.club_id = target_club
        and a.active = true
    ) row_data;
  end if;

  select count(*)
  into active_members
  from public.members
  where club_id = target_club
    and status = 'active';

  select count(*)
  into unread_notifications
  from public.notifications
  where club_id = target_club
    and (profile_id is null or profile_id = auth.uid())
    and read_at is null;

  select to_jsonb(e)
  into next_event
  from (
    select id, name, location, starts_at, status
    from public.events
    where club_id = target_club
      and starts_at >= now()
      and status in ('draft', 'published', 'active')
    order by starts_at
    limit 1
  ) e;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'total_balance', total_balance,
    'month_income', month_income,
    'month_expense', month_expense,
    'month_result', month_income - month_expense,
    'pending_fees', pending_fees,
    'active_members', active_members,
    'unread_notifications', unread_notifications,
    'next_event', next_event,
    'accounts', account_rows
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dashboard_summary_v1(target_club uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  total numeric;
  active_count integer;
  prospect_count integer;
  fee_count integer;
  income_month numeric;
  expense_month numeric;
begin
  select coalesce(sum(balance), 0)
  into total
  from public.treasury_account_balances_v1(target_club);

  select count(*)
  into active_count
  from public.members
  where club_id = target_club
    and status = 'active';

  select count(*)
  into prospect_count
  from public.members member
  where member.club_id = target_club
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.member_positions member_position
      join public.club_positions club_position
        on club_position.id = member_position.position_id
      where member_position.member_id = member.id
        and member_position.is_primary = true
        and club_position.code = 'prospect'
    );

  select count(*)
  into fee_count
  from public.fee_obligations
  where club_id = target_club
    and status in ('pending', 'partial');

  select coalesce(sum(amount), 0)
  into income_month
  from public.treasury_transactions
  where club_id = target_club
    and kind = 'income'
    and date_trunc('month', transaction_date::timestamp)
      = date_trunc('month', now());

  select coalesce(sum(amount), 0)
  into expense_month
  from public.treasury_transactions
  where club_id = target_club
    and kind = 'expense'
    and date_trunc('month', transaction_date::timestamp)
      = date_trunc('month', now());

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'total_balance', total,
    'active_members', active_count,
    'prospects', prospect_count,
    'pending_fees', fee_count,
    'month_income', income_month,
    'month_expense', expense_month
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_event_capacity_floor_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_occupancy bigint;
begin
  if new.capacity is null or new.capacity is not distinct from old.capacity then
    return new;
  end if;

  select
    (
      select count(*)
      from public.event_registrations er
      where er.event_id = new.id
    )
    + (
      select count(*)
      from public.event_registrations er
      where er.event_id = new.id
        and nullif(btrim(er.guest_name), '') is not null
    )
    + (
      select count(*)
      from public.event_registration_guests g
      join public.event_registrations er on er.id = g.registration_id
      where er.event_id = new.id
    )
    into v_occupancy;

  if v_occupancy > new.capacity then
    raise exception using
      errcode = 'P0001',
      message = 'EVENT_CAPACITY_BELOW_OCCUPANCY',
      detail = format(
        'Nova capacidade: %s; ocupação atual: %s.',
        new.capacity,
        v_occupancy
      );
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.global_search_v1(target_club uuid, search_text text, result_limit integer DEFAULT 30)
 RETURNS TABLE(result_type text, entity_id uuid, parent_id uuid, title text, subtitle text, detail text, module_code text, score integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  q text := btrim(coalesce(search_text, ''));
  nq text;
  max_rows integer := greatest(1, least(coalesce(result_limit, 30), 50));
  v_profile uuid;
  v_view_docs boolean;
  v_sensitive_docs boolean;
  v_manage_docs boolean;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Autenticação necessária.';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.club_memberships cm
    where cm.club_id = target_club
      and cm.profile_id = auth.uid()
      and cm.active = true
  ) then
    raise exception 'Sem acesso a este clube.';
  end if;

  v_profile := (select auth.uid());
  v_view_docs := public.has_club_permission(target_club, 'viewDocuments');
  v_sensitive_docs := public.has_club_permission(target_club, 'viewSensitiveDocuments');
  v_manage_docs := public.has_club_permission(target_club, 'manageDocuments');

  if char_length(q) < 2 then
    return;
  end if;
  if char_length(q) > 80 then
    q := left(q, 80);
  end if;

  nq := regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(q)), '[^a-z0-9]+', '', 'g');
  if char_length(nq) < 2 then
    return;
  end if;

  return query
  with candidates as (
    select
      'member'::text as result_type,
      m.id as entity_id,
      null::uuid as parent_id,
      coalesce(nullif(m.nickname, ''), m.full_name) as title,
      concat_ws(' • ', nullif(m.full_name, ''), case when m.member_number is null then null else 'N.º ' || m.member_number::text end, nullif(m.primary_role, '')) as subtitle,
      m.status::text as detail,
      'members'::text as module_code,
      case
        when regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(coalesce(m.nickname,''))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') = nq then 120
        when regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(coalesce(m.full_name,''))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') = nq then 115
        when m.member_number::text = q then 110
        when regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(coalesce(m.nickname,''))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') like nq || '%' then 95
        when regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(coalesce(m.full_name,''))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') like nq || '%' then 90
        else 70
      end as score
    from public.members m
    where m.club_id = target_club
      and public.has_club_permission(target_club, 'viewMembers')
      and (
        regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(coalesce(m.full_name,''))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') like '%' || nq || '%'
        or regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(coalesce(m.nickname,''))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') like '%' || nq || '%'
        or regexp_replace(coalesce(m.member_number::text,''), '[^0-9]+','','g') like '%' || nq || '%'
      )

    union all

    select
      'motorcycle',
      mm.id,
      mm.member_id,
      concat_ws(' ', nullif(mm.brand,''), nullif(mm.model,'')) as title,
      concat_ws(' • ', nullif(mm.registration,''), nullif(mm.nickname,''), case when mm.year is null then null else mm.year::text end) as subtitle,
      concat_ws(' • ', coalesce(nullif(m.nickname,''), m.full_name), case when mm.primary_motorcycle then 'Mota principal' else null end) as detail,
      'members',
      case
        when regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(coalesce(mm.registration,''))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') = nq then 130
        when regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(concat_ws(' ',mm.brand,mm.model))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') = nq then 115
        when regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(coalesce(mm.registration,''))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') like nq || '%' then 105
        else 75
      end
    from public.member_motorcycles mm
    join public.members m on m.id = mm.member_id and m.club_id = mm.club_id
    where mm.club_id = target_club
      and mm.active = true
      and public.has_club_permission(target_club, 'viewMembers')
      and (
        regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(coalesce(mm.brand,''))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') like '%' || nq || '%'
        or regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(coalesce(mm.model,''))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') like '%' || nq || '%'
        or regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(coalesce(mm.registration,''))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') like '%' || nq || '%'
        or regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(coalesce(mm.nickname,''))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') like '%' || nq || '%'
      )

    union all

    select
      'document',
      d.id,
      null::uuid,
      d.name,
      concat_ws(' • ', nullif(d.category,''), nullif(d.status,''), case when d.document_date is null then null else to_char(d.document_date,'DD/MM/YYYY') end),
      case when d.sensitive then 'Documento sensível' else null end,
      'documents',
      case
        when regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(coalesce(d.name,''))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') = nq then 110
        when regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(coalesce(d.name,''))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') like nq || '%' then 90
        else 65
      end
    from public.documents d
    where d.club_id = target_club
      -- Keep this visibility predicate aligned with the documents_select policy.
      and (
        (d.scope = 'personal' and (d.owner_profile_id = v_profile or v_manage_docs))
        or (d.scope = 'leadership' and v_sensitive_docs)
        or (
          d.scope in ('club','event_gallery','annual_book')
          and v_view_docs
          and (d.sensitive = false or v_sensitive_docs)
        )
      )
      and (
        regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(coalesce(d.name,''))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') like '%' || nq || '%'
        or regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(coalesce(d.category,''))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') like '%' || nq || '%'
        or regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(coalesce(d.tags,''))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') like '%' || nq || '%'
      )

    union all

    select
      'product',
      p.id,
      null::uuid,
      p.name,
      concat_ws(' • ', nullif(p.sku,''), nullif(p.category,''), case p.inventory_area when 'bar' then 'Bar' else 'Loja' end),
      case when p.active then 'Ativo' else 'Inativo' end,
      'inventory',
      case
        when regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(coalesce(p.sku,''))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') = nq then 120
        when regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(coalesce(p.name,''))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') = nq then 110
        when regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(coalesce(p.name,''))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') like nq || '%' then 90
        else 65
      end
    from public.products p
    where p.club_id = target_club
      and public.has_club_permission(target_club, 'viewInventory')
      and (
        regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(coalesce(p.name,''))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') like '%' || nq || '%'
        or regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(coalesce(p.sku,''))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') like '%' || nq || '%'
        or regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(coalesce(p.category,''))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') like '%' || nq || '%'
      )

    union all

    select
      'event',
      e.id,
      null::uuid,
      e.name,
      concat_ws(' • ', nullif(e.location,''), to_char(e.starts_at at time zone 'Europe/Lisbon','DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI')),
      e.status::text,
      'events',
      case
        when regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(coalesce(e.name,''))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') = nq then 110
        when regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(coalesce(e.name,''))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') like nq || '%' then 90
        else 65
      end
    from public.events e
    where e.club_id = target_club
      and public.has_club_permission(target_club, 'viewEvents')
      and (
        regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(coalesce(e.name,''))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') like '%' || nq || '%'
        or regexp_replace(extensions.unaccent(lower(coalesce(e.location,''))), '[^a-z0-9]+','','g') like '%' || nq || '%'
      )
  )
  select c.result_type, c.entity_id, c.parent_id, c.title, c.subtitle, c.detail, c.module_code, c.score
  from candidates c
  order by c.score desc, c.title asc
  limit max_rows;
end;
$function$

  where i.id=p_item
    and i.session_id=s.id
    and s.club_id=target_club

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.inventory_sync_aggregate_stock_v1(target_club uuid, p_product uuid, p_variant uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  perform set_config('bob.skip_stock_balance_sync','1',true);
  if p_variant is null then
    update public.products p set
      current_stock=(select coalesce(sum(b.quantity),0) from public.inventory_stock_balances b where b.club_id=target_club and b.product_id=p.id and b.variant_id is null),
      reserved_stock=(select coalesce(sum(b.reserved_quantity),0) from public.inventory_stock_balances b where b.club_id=target_club and b.product_id=p.id and b.variant_id is null)
    where p.id=p_product and p.club_id=target_club;
  else
    update public.product_variants pv set
      current_stock=(select coalesce(sum(b.quantity),0) from public.inventory_stock_balances b where b.club_id=target_club and b.product_id=p_product and b.variant_id=pv.id),
      reserved_stock=(select coalesce(sum(b.reserved_quantity),0) from public.inventory_stock_balances b where b.club_id=target_club and b.product_id=p_product and b.variant_id=pv.id)
    where pv.id=p_variant and pv.product_id=p_product;
    update public.products p set
      current_stock=(select coalesce(sum(pv.current_stock),0) from public.product_variants pv where pv.product_id=p.id and pv.active=true),
      reserved_stock=(select coalesce(sum(pv.reserved_stock),0) from public.product_variants pv where pv.product_id=p.id and pv.active=true)
    where p.id=p_product and p.club_id=target_club;
  end if;
  perform set_config('bob.skip_stock_balance_sync','0',true);
end $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_audit_log_page_v1(target_club uuid, p_created_from timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_created_before timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_entity_types text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], p_exclude_entity_types boolean DEFAULT false, p_action text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_actor_query text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_entity_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_cursor_created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_cursor_id bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS TABLE(id bigint, actor_id uuid, actor_name text, actor_email text, action text, entity_type text, entity_id text, before_data jsonb, after_data jsonb, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null
     or not public.has_club_permission(target_club, 'manageSettings') then
    raise exception 'Sem autorização para consultar a auditoria.';
  end if;

  if (p_cursor_created_at is null) <> (p_cursor_id is null) then
    raise exception 'Cursor de auditoria inválido.';
  end if;

  return query
  -- Preserva audit_log integralmente. A supressão é apenas de leitura e ocorre
  -- antes dos filtros, da ordenação e do limite de 50 + 1 registos.
  with visible_audit_log as materialized (
    select technical.*
    from public.audit_log technical
    where technical.club_id = target_club
      and not exists (
        select 1
        from public.audit_log functional
        where technical.entity_type = 'club_memberships'
          and technical.action = 'updated'
          and technical.actor_id is null
          and jsonb_typeof(technical.before_data) = 'object'
          and jsonb_typeof(technical.after_data) = 'object'
          and technical.before_data->>'profile_id'
            = technical.after_data->>'profile_id'
          and technical.before_data->>'access_role'
            is distinct from technical.after_data->>'access_role'
          -- Só o role e os carimbos de atualização podem ter mudado.
          -- active, member_id, created_at, created_by e qualquer outro campo
          -- mantêm-se na comparação: uma alteração adicional não é ocultada.
          and (technical.before_data - array['access_role', 'updated_at', 'updated_by'])
            = (technical.after_data - array['access_role', 'updated_at', 'updated_by'])
          and functional.club_id = technical.club_id
          and functional.entity_type = 'user_access'
          and functional.action = 'change_role'
          and functional.entity_id = technical.after_data->>'profile_id'
          and functional.data->>'from' = technical.before_data->>'access_role'
          and functional.data->>'to' = technical.after_data->>'access_role'
          and functional.actor_id is not null
          -- A Edge Function grava o evento funcional num pedido posterior.
          -- Janela explícita de 5 segundos; timestamp e id devem avançar.
          -- Sem correspondência completa, preserva-se a linha na leitura.
          and functional.created_at > technical.created_at
          and functional.created_at <= technical.created_at + interval '5 seconds'
          and functional.id > technical.id
      )
  )
  select
    a.id,
    a.actor_id,
    p.full_name::text,
    p.email::text,
    a.action,
    a.entity_type,
    a.entity_id,
    a.before_data,
    a.after_data,
    a.created_at
  from visible_audit_log a
  left join public.profiles p on p.id = a.actor_id
  where a.club_id = target_club
    and (p_created_from is null or a.created_at >= p_created_from)
    and (p_created_before is null or a.created_at < p_created_before)
    and (
      p_entity_types is null
      or cardinality(p_entity_types) = 0
      or (
        coalesce(p_exclude_entity_types, false)
        and (a.entity_type is null or not (a.entity_type = any(p_entity_types)))
      )
      or (
        not coalesce(p_exclude_entity_types, false)
        and a.entity_type = any(p_entity_types)
      )
    )
    and (p_action is null or a.action = p_action)
    and (
      p_actor_query is null
      or concat_ws(' ', p.full_name, p.email) ilike '%' || p_actor_query || '%'
    )
    and (
      p_search is null
      or concat_ws(' ', p.full_name, p.email, a.entity_type, a.action, a.entity_id)
        ilike '%' || p_search || '%'
    )
    and (p_entity_id is null or a.entity_id ilike '%' || p_entity_id || '%')
    and (
      p_cursor_created_at is null
      or a.created_at < p_cursor_created_at
      or (a.created_at = p_cursor_created_at and a.id < p_cursor_id)
    )
  order by a.created_at desc, a.id desc
  limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 50), 1), 50) + 1;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.member_milestones(target_club uuid, days_ahead integer DEFAULT 30)
 RETURNS TABLE(member_id uuid, member_name text, milestone_type text, milestone_label text, original_date date, next_date date, days_until integer, years_count integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with source_dates as (
    select
      m.id as member_id,
      m.full_name as member_name,
      v.milestone_type,
      v.milestone_label,
      v.original_date
    from public.members m
    cross join lateral (
      values
        ('birthday', 'Aniversário', m.birth_date),
        ('prospect_anniversary', 'Entrada como Prospect', m.prospect_joined_at),
        ('full_colors_anniversary', 'Full Color', m.full_colors_at)
    ) as v(milestone_type, milestone_label, original_date)
    where m.club_id = target_club
      and m.status in ('active', 'honorary')
      and v.original_date is not null
  ),
  next_occurrence as (
    select
      source_dates.*,
      case
        when make_date(
          extract(year from current_date)::int,
          extract(month from original_date)::int,
          extract(day from original_date)::int
        ) >= current_date
        then make_date(
          extract(year from current_date)::int,
          extract(month from original_date)::int,
          extract(day from original_date)::int
        )
        else make_date(
          extract(year from current_date)::int + 1,
          extract(month from original_date)::int,
          extract(day from original_date)::int
        )
      end as next_date
    from source_dates
  )
  select
    member_id,
    member_name,
    milestone_type,
    milestone_label,
    original_date,
    next_date,
    (next_date - current_date)::int as days_until,
    (
      extract(year from next_date)::int
      - extract(year from original_date)::int
    ) as years_count
  from next_occurrence
  where next_date <= current_date + days_ahead
  order by next_date, member_name;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.poll_participation_v1(target_club uuid, p_poll uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(eligible_count bigint, voted_count bigint, remaining_count bigint, participation_percent numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null
     or not public.has_club_permission(target_club, 'manageCommunication') then
    raise exception 'Sem autorização para consultar a participação.';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1 from public.polls p
    where p.id = p_poll and p.club_id = target_club
  ) then
    raise exception 'Votação não encontrada.';
  end if;

  return query
  -- O eleitorado é o atualmente elegível. A regra autoritativa permanece
  -- na função existente; alterações de elegibilidade não apagam votos.
  with eligible as materialized (
    select distinct cm.profile_id
    from public.club_memberships cm
    where cm.club_id = target_club
      and public.poll_member_eligible_internal_v1(target_club, cm.profile_id)
  ), totals as (
    select
      (select count(*) from eligible) as eligible_total,
      (
        select count(distinct v.profile_id)
        from public.poll_votes v
        join eligible e on e.profile_id = v.profile_id
        where v.club_id = target_club and v.poll_id = p_poll
      ) as voted_total
  )
  -- Uma pessoa com várias seleções conta uma vez. Não há identificadores
  -- nem resultados por opção na resposta, mesmo em votações identificadas.
  select
    t.eligible_total,
    t.voted_total,
    greatest(t.eligible_total - t.voted_total, 0::bigint),
    case when t.eligible_total = 0 then 0::numeric
      else t.voted_total::numeric / t.eligible_total::numeric * 100
    end
  from totals t;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refresh_financial_transaction_primary_v1(p_transaction uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_id uuid; v_path text;
begin
  select d.id,d.storage_path into v_id,v_path
  from public.financial_transaction_documents d
  where d.transaction_id=p_transaction and d.is_primary=true
  order by d.created_at,d.id
  limit 1;

  if v_id is null then
    select d.id,d.storage_path into v_id,v_path
    from public.financial_transaction_documents d
    where d.transaction_id=p_transaction
    order by d.created_at,d.id
    limit 1;
    if v_id is not null then
      update public.financial_transaction_documents
      set is_primary=true
      where id=v_id;
    end if;
  end if;

  update public.treasury_transactions t
  set document_path=v_path
  where t.id=p_transaction
    and t.document_path is distinct from v_path;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_weekly_dinner_finance_v1(target_club uuid, p_dinner uuid, p_meal_mode text, p_meal_quantity numeric, p_meal_revenue numeric, p_food_cost numeric, p_other_cost numeric, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ begin
  perform bob_dinner_private.require_access(target_club,true);
  perform 1 from public.weekly_dinners where id=p_dinner and club_id=target_club for update;
  if not found then raise exception 'Jantar não encontrado.'; end if;
  if exists(select 1 from public.weekly_dinner_finances where dinner_id=p_dinner and financial_status='closed') then
    raise exception 'Reabre o fecho financeiro antes de alterar valores.'; end if;
  -- Retain the signature for old clients, but reject new manual meal revenue.
  if p_meal_mode is distinct from 'automatic' or p_meal_quantity is distinct from 0::numeric
    or p_meal_revenue is distinct from 0::numeric then
    raise exception 'As refeições e receitas são registadas exclusivamente no BAR.'; end if;
  if p_meal_mode not in ('automatic','manual') or p_meal_mode is null
    or p_meal_quantity is null or p_meal_quantity<0 or p_meal_revenue is null or p_meal_revenue<0
    or p_food_cost is null or p_food_cost<0 or p_other_cost is null or p_other_cost<0 then
    raise exception 'Valores financeiros inválidos.'; end if;
  if p_meal_quantity::text in ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
    or p_meal_revenue::text in ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
    or p_food_cost::text in ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
    or p_other_cost::text in ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') then
    raise exception 'Valores financeiros têm de ser finitos.'; end if;
  insert into public.weekly_dinner_finances(club_id,dinner_id,meal_mode,manual_meal_quantity,manual_meal_revenue,
    food_cost_manual,other_cost_manual,notes,created_by,updated_by)
    values(target_club,p_dinner,p_meal_mode,p_meal_quantity,p_meal_revenue,p_food_cost,p_other_cost,p_notes,auth.uid(),auth.uid())
    on conflict(dinner_id) do update set meal_mode=excluded.meal_mode,manual_meal_quantity=excluded.manual_meal_quantity,
      manual_meal_revenue=excluded.manual_meal_revenue,food_cost_manual=excluded.food_cost_manual,
      other_cost_manual=excluded.other_cost_manual,notes=excluded.notes,updated_at=now(),updated_by=auth.uid();
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_financial_request_documents_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if new.treasury_transaction_id is null then return new; end if;
  if tg_op='UPDATE' and new.treasury_transaction_id is not distinct from old.treasury_transaction_id then
    return new;
  end if;

  insert into public.financial_transaction_documents(
    club_id,transaction_id,source_attachment_id,document_type,origin,
    storage_path,original_file_name,mime_type,file_size,is_primary,
    created_at,created_by,updated_at,updated_by
  )
  select
    a.club_id,new.treasury_transaction_id,a.id,
    case
      when a.kind='receipt' then 'receipt'
      when a.kind in ('member_payment_proof','club_payment_proof') then 'payment_proof'

    'request',a.storage_path,a.original_file_name,a.mime_type,a.file_size,false,
    a.created_at,a.created_by,a.updated_at,a.updated_by
  from public.financial_request_attachments a
  where a.request_id=new.id
  on conflict do nothing;

  perform public.refresh_financial_transaction_primary_v1(new.treasury_transaction_id);
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.treasury_account_balance_v1(target_account uuid)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select
    a.opening_balance
    + coalesce(sum(
        case
          when t.kind = 'income' and t.account_id = a.id then t.amount
          when t.kind = 'expense' and t.account_id = a.id then -t.amount
          when t.kind = 'transfer' and t.account_id = a.id then -t.amount
          when t.kind = 'transfer' and t.destination_account_id = a.id then t.amount
          else 0
        end
      ), 0)
  from public.treasury_accounts a
  left join public.treasury_transactions t
    on t.club_id = a.club_id
   and (t.account_id = a.id or t.destination_account_id = a.id)
  where a.id = target_account
  group by a.id, a.opening_balance;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.treasury_account_balances_v1(target_club uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, name text, account_type text, balance numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Autenticação necessária.' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if not public.has_club_permission(target_club, 'viewTreasury') then
    raise exception 'Sem autorização para consultar a tesouraria.' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    account.id,
    account.name::text,
    account.account_type::text,
    account.opening_balance
    + coalesce(
        sum(
          case
            when tx.kind = 'income'
              and tx.account_id = account.id
              then tx.amount
            when tx.kind = 'expense'
              and tx.account_id = account.id
              then -tx.amount
            when tx.kind = 'transfer'
              and tx.account_id = account.id
              then -tx.amount
            when tx.kind = 'transfer'
              and tx.destination_account_id = account.id
              then tx.amount
            else 0
          end
        ),
        0
      ) as balance
  from public.treasury_accounts account
  left join public.treasury_transactions tx
    on tx.club_id = account.club_id
   and (
     tx.account_id = account.id
     or tx.destination_account_id = account.id
   )
  where account.club_id = target_club
    and account.active = true
  group by
    account.id,
    account.name,
    account.account_type,
    account.opening_balance
  order by account.name;
end;
$function$

  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'description',t.description,'amount',t.amount,
    'transaction_date',t.transaction_date) order by t.transaction_date desc,t.id),'[]'::jsonb) into expenses
    from public.treasury_transactions t where t.club_id=target_club and t.kind::text='expense'
      and t.reversal_of is null and not exists(select 1 from public.treasury_transactions r where r.reversal_of=t.id)
      and not exists(select 1 from public.weekly_dinner_expenses l where l.transaction_id=t.id)
      and coalesce(t.source_type,'') not in ('bar','bar_purchase','bar_operation','inventory','stock_purchase');
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',s.id,'customer_label',s.customer_label,
    'total_amount',s.total_amount,'completed_at',s.completed_at,'weekly_dinner_id',s.weekly_dinner_id,
    'weekly_dinner_dish',d.dish) order by s.completed_at desc,s.id),'[]'::jsonb) into sales
    from public.bar_sales s left join public.weekly_dinners d
      on d.club_id=s.club_id and d.id=s.weekly_dinner_id
    where s.club_id=target_club and s.status='completed';
  return jsonb_build_object('expenses',expenses,'sales',sales);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.weekly_dinner_financial_history_v1(target_club uuid, p_year integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare rows jsonb; totals record; begin
  perform bob_dinner_private.require_access(target_club);
  if p_year is null or p_year<1900 or p_year>2200 then raise exception 'Ano inválido.'; end if;
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',d.id,'dinner_date',d.dinner_date,'dish',d.dish,
    'financial_status',coalesce(f.financial_status,'none'),'summary',case when f.financial_status='closed' then f.snapshot else null end)
    order by d.dinner_date desc,d.id),'[]'::jsonb) into rows
    from public.weekly_dinners d left join public.weekly_dinner_finances f on f.dinner_id=d.id
    where d.club_id=target_club and extract(year from d.dinner_date)=p_year;
  select count(*) n,coalesce(sum((f.snapshot->>'total_revenue')::numeric),0) revenue,
    coalesce(sum((f.snapshot->>'total_cost')::numeric),0) cost,coalesce(sum((f.snapshot->>'result')::numeric),0) result
    into totals from public.weekly_dinners d join public.weekly_dinner_finances f on f.dinner_id=d.id
    where d.club_id=target_club and extract(year from d.dinner_date)=p_year and f.financial_status='closed';
  return jsonb_build_object('rows',rows,'closed_count',totals.n,'total_revenue',totals.revenue,'total_cost',totals.cost,
    'result',totals.result,'margin_percent',case when totals.revenue>0 then totals.result/totals.revenue*100 else 0 end);
end $function$

AS $function$
  select exists (

    join public.members m on m.id=r.member_id and m.club_id=r.club_id
    where r.club_id=target_club and r.member_id=p_member
      and (
        r.force_included=true
        or (
          r.enabled=true and r.availability_status='active'

          and not exists (
            select 1 from public.weekly_officer_absences a
            where a.club_id=target_club and a.member_id=p_member

        )

  );
